CS Software Engineer

Entry Level

E80 Group develops automated and integrated intralogistics solutions for manufacturers across several consumer goods sectors. The CS Software Engineer develops, maintains, tests, deploys, and optimizes software supporting automated material handling and logistics systems, while also providing customer support, upgrades, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement in live industrial environments.
Logistics
Manufacturing

Supply Chain Management

H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain software applications using C#, SQL, and related technologies
Support software implementation, testing, and deployment for industrial automation systems
Modify, customize, and enhance existing software solutions running in active customer operations
Troubleshoot software issues and implement fixes or performance improvements
Collaborate with internal software and customer service functions to analyze requirements and resolve technical issues
Contribute to software simulations, testing activities, and system validation
Support the development and release of new software features, modules, or applications
Ensure software solutions meet safety, reliability, and performance requirements
Participate in customer meetings and on-site activities related to software support, upgrades, and optimization
Maintain accurate technical documentation in accordance with development standards
Adopt and use AI‑driven tools to support software development activities, contributing to increased efficiency, quality, and maintainability of software solutions
